environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in EKS (Fargate profile, namespace: 'transfers') with Istio 1.19 sidecar injection enabled. The mesh operates in STRICT mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication policy mesh-wide). An AuthorizationPolicy resource named 'deny-cross-namespace-default' is applied to the 'transfers' namespace workloads with the following spec: action DENY for sources where source.namespace is not in ['payments']. A second AuthorizationPolicy 'allow-payments-only' with action ALLOW restricts to source.principal matching 'cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/payments-service'. Note: the Istio proxy (Envoy) terminates connections at the sidecar before they reach the application container, meaning timing measurements from outside the pod reflect Envoy processing time, not application-level comparison time. The attacker pod would need to be in the 'payments' namespace with the correct service account to even establish a connection, and cross-namespace pod creation is restricted by Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-namespace-creation' requiring group 'platform-admins' for namespace 'payments'.

config.service_mesh: Istio 1.19, STRICT mTLS, sidecar injection enabled
config.admission_control: Kyverno ClusterPolicy restricting pod creation in payments namespace to platform-admins group
config.network_policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allowing ingress to transfers pods only from payments namespace pods on port 8080
